Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + lemon water (no sugar)
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + soaked almonds (6 nos)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + fresh fruit (100 g)
Breakfast: Option 1: Vegetable upma (80 g) with mixed vegetables (50 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Poha (80 g) with peanuts (15 g) and fruits (50 g) + buttermilk (150 ml)
Option 3: Ragi porridge (150 g) with nuts (10 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Brown rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + mixed vegetable curry (100 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 2: Chapati (2 medium) + paneer bhurji (120 g) + dal (100 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 3: Millet khichdi (150 g) with vegetables (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Fruit bowl (100 g) + green tea (200 ml)
Option 2: Roasted makhana (30 g) + buttermilk (150 ml)
Dinner: Option 1: Vegetable soup (250 ml) + 2 chapatis + lightly cooked vegetables (100 g)
Option 2: Mixed vegetable stir-fry (150 g) + ragi roti (2 small)
Option 3: Paneer tikka (100 g) with salad (50 g) + small bowl dal (100 g)

Notes_and_Tips: For thyroid and PCOS: focus on balanced meals with fiber and controlled carbs.
Prefer whole grains and millets; avoid refined flour and sugar-heavy foods.
When craving sweets, choose fruit or small portion of jaggery with curd.
Keep easy healthy snacks (fruits, makhana) during long field work hours.
Stay hydrated and include gentle movement like walking or yoga daily.
Plan meals ahead to avoid fried or sugary convenience foods when stressed.
